688:t_3:507.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then we'll take care of both shares at once!」

688:t_3:511.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「Sorry, $$アレルヤ$$! This one's my turn!」

688:t_3:512.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Then I'll represent the $$エレメント$$s!!」

688:t_3:513.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'm counting on you to take care of ours, $$シルヴィア$$.」

688:t_3:515.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do it, $$シンジ$$! One punch, no hard feelings afterward, and we end it!」

688:t_3:517.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm leaving it to you, $$ブレラ$$.」

688:t_3:518.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Then I'll go with output at maximum.」

688:t_3:522.en:
$$宗介$$
「Time to wrap this up, I suppose.」

688:t_3:525.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「H-hey, wait! An Armor Magnum is really out of the question!」

688:t_3:527.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「J-joking...?! Your opponent is $$キリコ$$, you know!」

688:t_3:528.en:
$$キリコ$$
「If I'd meant to kill you, I'd have done it from the start.」

688:t_3:529.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You pulled a trick like $$バインドスペル$$ on us. I'm taking at least this much.」

688:t_3:530.en:
$$ランド$$
「Oh boy... your prized exterior is all banged up. I'll fix it for you later.」

688:t_3:532.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I have plenty I'd like to say. But for now, let's move forward.」

688:t_3:533.en:
$$バナージ$$
「At the very least, we feel the same way about wanting to defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:534.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But if you ever betray us...」

688:t_3:535.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Then be prepared for the consequences.」

688:t_3:536.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I understand, so please, $$正太郎$$! Put the $$Ｖコン$$ down!」

688:t_3:537.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Let me be clear: this is strictly an emergency measure until the $$御使い$$s are defeated. As for what comes after, we will set up a proper forum for discussion.」

688:t_3:538.en:
$$桂$$
「For now, keep the AG Mask on. At least that way we can talk without any unnecessary preconceptions.」

688:t_3:539.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... that's fine with me. I... rather liked that position.」

688:t_3:540.en:
$$勝平$$
「He hasn't shown one bit of remorse!」

688:t_3:541.en:
$$万丈$$
「It's pointless to demand that sort of thing from him.」

688:t_3:542.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Let's hope Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$, who is inside him, acts as his brake.」

688:t_3:543.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Even so, we have a common enemy in the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:544.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「To fight such a powerful enemy, we may have to accept the clean with the dirty.」

688:t_3:545.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Joining forces even with former enemies - truly befitting those who have touched the cosmic truth of living together.」

688:t_3:546.en:
$$セツコ$$
「What am I to do with you...」

688:t_3:547.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't get carried away, $$ＡＧ$$. For the sake of living, we're not about to let villains off the hook, either.」

688:t_3:549.en:
$$トライア$$
「There's no time left to spare, either. First we have to move forward.」

688:t_3:550.en:
$$エスター$$
「That's easy to say, but where should we head?」

688:t_3:551.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$御使い$$s are probably keeping track of our movements through the $$烙印$$ they carved themselves.」

688:t_3:552.en:
$$トライア$$
「Conversely, if we trace it, we should reach where they are.」

688:t_3:553.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Is something like that possible?」

688:t_3:554.en:
$$トライア$$
「Until now it was only theory, but in this $$カオス・コスモス$$ it should be possible.」

688:t_3:555.en:
$$トライア$$
「After all, this is a universe where perception born of will holds power. What those guys are after takes on a much clearer form.」

688:t_3:556.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「A universe where perception holds power... huh.」

688:t_3:557.en:
$$シモン$$
「So that's why $$真化融合$$ and Tengen Toppa were possible.」

688:t_3:558.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Then surely we'll meet her, too...」

688:t_3:560.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Is there someone you know in this universe?」

688:t_3:561.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Joy, anger, sorrow, pleasure... The last one remaining of the four $$御使い$$s...」

688:t_3:562.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The woman I sensed when we were transferred to the $$カオス・コスモス$$ before...」

688:t_3:564.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think she's the $$御使い$$ who governs sorrow.」

688:t_3:565.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The only one among them who helps us...」

688:t_10:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
($n... You're thinking about $$マキ#pilot$$, aren't you...)

688:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(A woman watching over a wounded man... Now that is an irresistible situation...)

688:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Stop that idle peeping. All we can do now is hope that time resolves it.)

688:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That's easy for you to say, but the stirrings in the hearts of everyone in $c are the source of the all-important $$Ｚチップ$$s, you see.)

688:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
($n, who settled it with his own hands, produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. Let's add that to the stock.)

688:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(How many more tragedies must we repeat before we can overthrow them...)

688:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Who knows... We bet everything on $c. Now that it's come to this, all we can do is see it through to the end.)

688:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(And the final key will be him... $F, huh...)

688:t_10:16.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$, did you realize who AG really was?」

688:t_10:18.en:
$$トライア$$
「But I wanted to believe in the heart that Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$ inside him bet on that nitwit.」

688:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Really now? That's awfully romantic for you, $$トライア$$.」

688:t_10:20.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「As I thought, your true nature is that $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$ from the $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

688:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... You mustn't get angry, $$ツィーネ$$.」

688:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For the sake of 《$$レーベン$$》 and 《$$シュラン$$》, who lost themselves in the chaos of the multiverse, we have to seize the future.」

688:t_10:23.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「That distortion of theirs is something you drove them to...!」

688:t_10:24.en:
$$エスター$$
「Oh, there you are! Chief, $$マルグリット$$, $$ツィーネ$$, it's time to eat.」
